title: clerodendrum intermedium
intro: Clerodendrum intermedium, commonly known as the tree glorybower, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum intermedium include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
